title: PublicHealth AirPollutionClinicPanel

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the air quality and respiratory health analysis. The study analyzed 120 days of panel data examining the relationship between PM2.5 and respiratory clinic visits. Key findings: (1) Significant positive association between PM2.5 and respiratory visits (0.47 visits per μg/m³, p=0.035); (2) Immediate same-day effect with limited lagged impacts; (3) Dose-response relationship confirmed; (4) Results robust across sensitivity analyses. Deliverables include: comprehensive analysis code (code/analysis.py), 10 publication-quality figures (report/images/), intermediate outputs (outputs/), and a complete research report (report/report.md) with methodology, results, discussion, and policy implications.
